title: Spawn Plan v1
description: Dry-run spawn plan produced by the reviewer orchestrator's spawn_session planner. Validates a mission packet against coordination constraints and returns whether the mission could safely be launched. Real subprocess spawning is deferred to the executer slice.

mission_id.description: Mission identifier from the validated mission packet.

parent_sprint_id.description: Sprint that would launch this mission.

parent_review_id.description: Review that produced the sprint decision.

can_spawn.description: Whether the mission can be spawned.

refusal_code.description: Canonical refusal code when can_spawn is false.

active_child_count.description: Current active child sessions from coordination state.

would_claim_task.description: Whether this mission would claim a coordination task.

would_reserve_paths.description: Whether this mission would reserve paths.

reservation_mode.description: Reservation mode if would_reserve_paths is true.

checkpoint_policy.description: Checkpoint policy from the mission packet.

coordination_policy_summary.description: Human-readable summary of the coordination policy.

overlapping_path_hashes.description: Salted hashes of overlapping paths if write overlap detected.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings about the spawn plan.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of plan creation.

forbidden_fields.description: Field names that MUST NOT appear.
